purpose.canonical: A creator-owned public profile that answers visitor questions and preserves context for better inbound.
purpose.pricingTruth: No billing exists in the current product; free today is not presented as a permanent guarantee.
purpose.currentState: Live and maintained for personal use. Person and agent profiles ship today; company and team workflows remain the next validation.

design.direction: public-inbound-desk in the Onyx reading-room system

limitations: The low-end slow-3G profile has 3.31s LCP, but the coverage p75 is 1.51s and Lighthouse found no actionable opportunity; preserving the defining editorial type is the deliberate tradeoff.
The already-running local Worker retained its pre-migration D1 handle; current production profile and creation routes were separately verified 200.
No deployment, release, billing action, or provider mutation was performed.
